title: Moonlit Breakwater: The Diplomat's Harbor Charter
premise: In a drowned port exposed at the edge of the lunar tide, the diplomat must negotiate a route across a disputed threshold using a sealed bilingual accord.
ending: Recover the Harbor Charter and return with the mutual passage covenant; Night Harbor Guild can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive undertow gate while evading the lighthouse revenant without sacrificing the mutual passage covenant.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Night Harbor Guild to witness the sealed bilingual accord.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal the faction's old promise
